teamSpecialists.name: Diego Brito
teamSpecialists.bio:
I'm a Motion Designer who believes that every movement should have a purpose.

My background is in graphic design and art direction, where I spent more than 10 years learning about composition, hierarchy, branding, and visual communication. Over the last few years, I specialized in motion design, mainly creating explainer videos and product demos for SaaS companies.
 
Today, I approach animation with a designer's eye and a storyteller's mindset. Before adding movement, I ask what the scene is trying to say and how animation can make that message clearer.

When I'm not designing, you'll probably find me reading about philosophy, history, or the ideas that have shaped human thinking. Understanding how people think helps me create stories that connect with them.

projects.description:
The symbol at the beginning of the logo resembles two opposing yet connected forms, inspired by the shape of a butterfly. A butterfly represents transformation, freedom, beauty, and evolution concepts that strongly connect with fashion and personal expression. Its symmetrical structure also creates a sense of balance, harmony, and individuality.

The symbol can additionally be interpreted as two forms moving toward each other, representing connection, motion, and the continuous evolution of style. This directly supports the brand philosophy of “Move With Style.”
The custom MOVA wordmark uses clean geometric construction with elegant curves and sharp details. The contrast between soft and structured shapes gives the logo a balance of fashion-forward creativity and premium sophistication.

The warm terracotta/brown color direction communicates warmth, confidence, authenticity, and refined luxury, while the cream/off-white creates an elegant contrast and enhances the premium character of the identity.

Overall, the MOVA logo represents a fashion brand that encourages people to embrace change, express individuality, and move confidently through life with style. The identity is intentionally versatile, allowing it to work beautifully across clothing, labels, packaging, retail spaces, social media, and digital platforms.

projects.description:
This mobile UI design focuses on a modern, Gamified EdTech experience. It effectively balances dense data visualization with a clean, approachable aesthetic, primarily using a palette of vibrant purples, soft pastels, and high-contrast call-to-action (CTA) elements. Visual Hierarchy & Branding
The app utilizes a "Card-Based" layout, which is excellent for organizing disparate pieces of information like scores, rankings, and topic breakdowns without overwhelming the user.

Color Palette: A sophisticated mix of Deep Purple (#5D2EC0) for primary actions and "Success" indicators, paired with soft background tints. High-visibility oranges and corals are used strategically for "Recommended" or "Action Required" sections.
Typography: A clean, geometric Sans-Serif font ensures legibility. Large headings are used for primary stats (e.g., "69%"), while smaller, lighter weights handle metadata (e.g., "35min/45min").
Iconography: Linear, colorful icons provide visual anchors for metrics like time spent, correct answers, and rankings.

faqs.question: What services does Digital With Habib offer?
faqs.answer: We specialize in Brand Identity, UI/UX Design, Web Development (custom websites & landing pages), SaaS & App Design, and Video/Motion graphics.

faqs.question: How do we start working together?
faqs.answer: Simply reach out via our contact form, email, or chat on WhatsApp. We will discuss your goals, outline a clear scope and timeline, and provide a transparent proposal.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Most branding and landing page projects take between 2 to 4 weeks, while comprehensive web apps or full design systems take 4 to 8 weeks depending on complexity.

faqs.question: How do revisions work?
faqs.answer: We believe in collaborative refinement. Each project milestone includes structured review cycles to make sure you are 100% satisfied with the outcome.

faqs.question: Can you work with teams in different timezones?
faqs.answer: Yes! We work asynchronously with founders and teams across the US, Europe, Asia, and globally with smooth communication and regular milestone updates.
